label: ASCII text
desc: A word rendered as living ASCII art: characters swell in a travelling wave, the pointer acts as a lens and clicks send ripples.
use: Hero word or logotype for a developer, terminal or retro-tech landing page (fills its parent).

label: Circular text
desc: Text set around a ring that turns slowly; hover can speed it up, slow it, reverse it or pause it, and a centre slot holds an icon or label.
use: Rotating badge beside a hero heading, a 'scroll down' or 'new' sticker, or a footer seal.

label: Curved loop
desc: A marquee that scrolls along an arched line; drag to scrub and flip direction, arrow keys and Space steer it.
use: Full-width ticker between landing sections, announcement or client-name band.

label: Depth text
desc: Big text with a solid shaded extrusion whose direction follows the pointer; arrow keys steer it and touch screens get a slow sway.
use: Section title or hero word on a landing page where a bold 3D feel is wanted.

label: Echo text
desc: Solid text followed by outlined echoes that ripple outwards (or trail away) and fade; hover or tap throws them further.
use: Hero headline or a single emphasised word on a landing page or announcement band.

label: Falling text
desc: A sentence whose words drop under gravity, bounce and pile up on the bottom edge; trigger by click, hover, scroll or button, then Reset.
use: Playful 404 or empty state, closing statement of a landing page, quote reveal.

label: Fold text
desc: Text cut into panels that fold like a 3D accordion: breathes on its own, previews on hover or focus, and click pins it folded.
use: Hero word or section title that reacts on hover; a toggleable headline.

label: Fuzzy text
desc: Canvas text whose scanlines tremble sideways for a furry static edge; the pointer or a touch raises the interference.
use: 404 or error headings, retro or broadcast-styled hero text.

label: Glitch text
desc: Text with a brand-coloured chromatic split and torn slices that jump in short bursts (loop) or on hover; pure CSS.
use: Hero or error heading, tech or gaming landing pages; can be a real h1/h2 via the as prop.

label: Masked heading
desc: A heading whose lines rise out of a clipping mask on scroll, filled with a drifting brand gradient and a pointer-following highlight.
use: Section and hero headings on landing pages (renders a real h1/h2/h3).
